content.short: Velodrome is a DeFi protocol on Optimism with swapping, vesting, bribing and liquidity pool features.
content.description: Velodrome is a DeFi protocol developed by the veDAO team, a Fantom-native project led by Andre Conje, established as a pillar of the Solidly ecosystem. Users with Ethereum-native wallets can access the Velodrome interface to engage in on-chain activity. The protocol offers a suite of features, including swapping, vesting, bribing, and a liquidity pool, designed to support liquidity and governance across multiple networks.
